subject: Monthly KPI sync — leadership readout readiness & owner action items
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly KPI dashboard — leadership readout readiness & owner action items

Team — attaching the Aug monthly KPI pack (PDF) and an editable owner tracker. This is the condensed set I plan to use in the leadership readout next Wednesday. High level notes:

- Latency: p95 inference latency improved 6% vs July (batching / KV cache changes). Still seeing a thin tail during APAC spikes (see slide 5).
- Cost: token cost per 1k decreased 4% after quantization rollout on v2 models, but embedding costs are up 12% driven by increased ingestion from a single large customer (Acme Cloud).
- Uptime: 99.96% for infra; one incident on Aug 12 with a fallback purple path — root cause tracked in ENG-1298.
- Usage: prod QPS up 24% month-over-month; 3 customers account for 58% of spikes in the evening window (PST).

Asks for prep: please review slides 4–7 and add owner names + short remediation text in the owner_action_tracker spreadsheet by EOD Tuesday. Specific owner asks below: 

- Latency tail in APAC (slide 5): need an owner for a short mitigation plan (route by region + priority queue policy). Suggested owner: Jonas.
- Embedding cost spike (slide 6): coordinate with Acme to understand ingestion delta and propose smoothing or batching controls. Suggested owner: Irene; we should ask Acme for their ingestion timeseries.
- Incident follow-through (slide 7): confirm that follow-up checklist is done (postmortem comments, alerts updated). Suggested owner: Soojin.

If you have any last-minute changes to the slides or want a different framing in the exec readout, flag them in the Drive link. I will circulate a speaker plan on Wednesday morning.

Attachments: monthly_kpi_dashboard_aug2026.pdf, owner_action_tracker_Aug2026.xlsx

Thanks —
Mateo
Sr. PM, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly KPI dashboard — leadership readout readiness & owner action items

Thanks Mateo — reviewed slides. Quick comments inline and a few clarifications: 

- Slide 5 (APAC latency): I can own a 48-hour mitigation plan to add geo-routing + transient cache warming; will put owners in tracker.
- Slide 6 (Embedding cost): I pulled a quick usage dump and confirmed Acme's ingestion doubled on Aug 9 after a pipeline change on their side. I'll reach out to Claire and ask for a short runbook of their export cadence.
- Slide 7 (Incident checklist): postmortem draft is in the linked JIRA (ENG-1298). I updated the alert thresholds recommendation — please review.

Also, suggest we add a one-slide risk heatmap for the QBR to call out top two financial exposure areas (embeddings and burst traffic). That will make the ask clearer for leadership.

On the owner_action_tracker: I'm adding estimated ETA and a simple success metric for each remediation (e.g., reduce p95 tail by 20% during APAC peak).

Onward —
Irene
Director, Reliability
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly KPI dashboard — leadership readout readiness & owner action items

Looks good. I've added the incident follow-up checklist items to the tracker (postmortem link, alert runbook updates, and a brief customer-communication note).

A couple of pragmatic asks for the exec slide:
- Please include an explicit ask on the one-pager: "Approve temporary burst budget for Sep to cover client onboarding spikes" with a $X estimate (finance will want a number).
- For the latency mitigation, if Jonas can scope the effort and give a one-week sprint plan, I can approve rollout readiness for blue-green testing.

I will not be in the Wednesday all-hands but can provide speaker notes.

Thanks —
Soojin
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Irene / Mateo — thanks for the heads up and for flagging the ingestion increase. I pulled our deployment notes: we rolled out a new export pipeline on Aug 9 which doubled export frequency for the dev->prod staging bucket. The change was unintentional for some teams — we've already reverted the default to the old cadence for most customers.

I'm looping in billing as requested to make sure we're aligned on reported tokens vs billed tokens. For next steps:
- I'll send you a short timeseries of ingestion per hour for the last 30 days (should be in your inbox by tomorrow).
- We can schedule a 30-min sync to walk the export behavior and agree on throttling or batching approaches.

Regards,
Claire Briggs
Director, Platform Integrations
Acme Cloud
